theorems.name: Submission.stationary_ratio_limit_of_annulus_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (R : ℝ), (∀ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ < R → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ V.normalRadialSq ξ x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) V.weight ∧ V.weight.real (closedBall ξ ρ) / ρ ^ n - V.weight.real (closedBall ξ σ) / σ ^ n = ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, V.normalRadialSq ξ x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n ∂V.weight) → MonotoneOn (fun ρ ↦ V.weight.real (closedBall ξ ρ) / ρ ^ n) (Ioo 0 R) ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < R → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ V.normalRadialSq ξ x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n) (closedBall ξ ρ) V.weight ∧ V.weight.real (closedBall ξ ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n) - V.density ξ = (omega n)⁻¹ * ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ, V.normalRadialSq ξ x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n ∂V.weight) ∧ (0 < R → V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < R → V.density ξ ≤ V.weight.real (closedBall ξ ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n)
